_comment: XML document manifest for the TEI Gallery. `bundled` XML are AUTO-DISCOVERED by scripts/build-catalog.mjs from docs/xml/<id>/tei.xml — just drop a folder and run `npm run catalog`, no edit here needed. List a `bundled` entry below only to pin its order (manifest entries come first, in this order; auto-discovered extras follow, sorted by id). `remote` documents must be listed here (they can't be scanned); they are fetched live (host must allow CORS) and `fallback` metadata is used only when the fetch fails at generation time. Optional `recommend: "<xsl-id>"` on any entry sets the document's RECOMMENDED stylesheet — shown as an 'open recommended view' link on its gallery card. Omit it to auto-derive from the XSL whose `Sample` is this document; set `recommend: ""` to suppress.
